[[Precious metals]] | website = {{url | http://www.rajeshindia.com}} }} '''Rajesh Exports Limited''' is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] gold retailer headquartered in [[Bangalore]], [[Karnataka]]. The company refines, designs, and sells gold and jewelry. It was ranked 7th on the [[Fortune India 500]] list in 2020, with revenues of [[Indian rupee|₹]]2.90 [[trillion]],{{Cite web|title=Rajesh Exports - Fortune 500 List 2020 - Fortune India|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/fortune-500/company/rajesh-exports?year=2020|access-date=2021-01-12|website=www.fortuneindia.com|language=en}} and 462nd in the [[Fortune Global 500]]. The present managing director is Prashant Mehta and the executive chairman is Rajesh Mehta.{{Cite web|title=Rajesh Exports {{!}} About Us {{!}} Management {{!}} Gold and Diamond Jewellery Manufacturer|url=http://www.rajeshindia.com/management|access-date=2021-01-12|website=www.rajeshindia.com}} == History == The company was founded in 1989{{cite web |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=8667003 |title=Rajesh Exports Limited: Private Company Information |publisher=Bloomberg |date=2017-09-30 |accessdate=2017-12-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171216034809/https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=8667003 |archive-date=16 December 2017 |url-status=live }} as Rajesh Exports Limited by [[Rajesh Mehta]] and his brother Prashant Mehta both born in a middle class [[Jain]] family.{{cite web |url=http://www.forbesindia.com/article/india-rich-list-2016/the-gold-rush-how-rajesh-mehtas-out-of-the-box-ideas-helped-him-build-his-jewellery-empire/45105/1 |title=The gold rush: How Rajesh Mehta's out of the box ideas helped him build his jewellery empire |work=Forbes India |date=2016-12-14 |accessdate=2017-12-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181025182158/http://www.forbesindia.com/article/india-rich-list-2016/the-gold-rush-how-rajesh-mehtas-out-of-the-box-ideas-helped-him-build-his-jewellery-empire/45105/1 |archive-date=25 October 2018 |url-status=live }} The brothers started manufacturing in a ten-person shop located in their garage in [[Bangalore]]. By 1990, the company opened a retail front and rapidly expanded. In 2001, the company built a large manufacturing facility in Bangalore. In 2011, the company raised $134.9 million by converting the [[foreign currency convertible bonds]] they had issued in 2007.{{Cite web|title=Rajesh Exports raises $134.9 million through FCCBs|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/rajesh-exports-raises-1349-million-through-fccbs/article23070454.ece|access-date=2020-11-05|website=@businessline|date=3 November 2011 |language=en}} In 2015, the company acquired the largest gold refiner in the world, [[Valcambi]] of [[Balerna]], [[Switzerland]], for $400 million.{{cite news |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Rajesh-Exports-buys-Swiss-gold-refiner-for-400m/articleshow/48243771.cms |title=Rajesh Exports buys Swiss gold refiner for $400m |newspaper=The Times of India |date=28 July 2015 |accessdate=31 January 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180910093007/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Rajesh-Exports-buys-Swiss-gold-refiner-for-400m/articleshow/48243771.cms |archive-date=10 September 2018 |url-status=live }} As of 2018, they were planning to expand their Shubh Jewellers retail store.{{Cite news|url=https://newshour.press/business/rajesh-exports-md-eyes-bigger-pie-retail-sector-plans-expansion-shubh-jewellers-stores/|title=Rajesh Exports MD eyes bigger pie in retail sector, plans expansion of Shubh Jewellers stores - News Hour|date=2018-07-07|work=News Hour|access-date=2018-08-18|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180818115336/https://newshour.press/business/rajesh-exports-md-eyes-bigger-pie-retail-sector-plans-expansion-shubh-jewellers-stores/|archive-date=18 August 2018|url-status=live}} In 2026, the company was accused of having committed a fraud of 15 lakh crore by [[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] (SEBI).{{Cite web |title=SEBI Says Gujarati Businessman Hid Rs 15 Lakh Crore From Gatekeepers and Regulators in India |url=https://thewire.in/business/sebi-says-gujarati-businessman-hid-rs-15-lakh-crore-from-gatekeepers-and-regulators-in-india |access-date=2026-06-04 |website=The Wire |language=en}} ==See also== {{Portal|Companies }} * [[List of companies of India]] * [[List of largest companies by revenue]] * [[List of corporations by market capitalization]] * [[Make in India]] * [[Forbes Global 2000]] * [[Fortune India 500]] == References== {{reflist}}{{Nifty 200 companies}} [[Category:Companies established in 1989]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Bengaluru]] [[Category:Jewellery companies of India]] [[Category:1989 establishments in Karnataka]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{India-company-stub}}
extract: Rajesh Exports Limited is an Indian multinational gold retailer headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka. The company refines, designs, and sells gold and jewelry. It was ranked 7th on the Fortune India 500 list in 2020, with revenues of ₹2.90 trillion, and 462nd in the Fortune Global 500. The present managing director is Prashant Mehta and the executive chairman is Rajesh Mehta.
